title: GUARD (fixed in 87a079a0a1) — was: the `<all>` match `compadd -C` adds after `addexpl(0)` was not counted on the listed `-X` explanation: `%n` one short, and with no words the explanation line vanished

observed.notes: Src/Zle/compcore.c addexpl c:3158 `addlinknode(expls, curexpl)` puts the curexpl OBJECT on the list, so the `curexpl->count++` of every later match (c:2062 addmatch, c:3018-3021 add_match_data) also counts on the listed entry. addmatches calls addexpl(0) at c:2609-2610 and only then adds `<all>` (c:2611-2613) and the -E dummies (c:2615-2616), so zsh lists `ex n=3` for two words plus `<all>`.

observed_when_diverging.recorded_under: main at 87c1835211 plus peer-lane uncommitted edits, target/debug/zshrs zshrs 0.13.56 (built 2026-10-28 02:10), scratch probe p136 under the command name fzl4p136

retired.why: compcore.rs addexpl pushed a COPY of curexpl onto expls, so increments made after the push never reached the listed entry. CUREXPL_NODE now records which list entry is the curexpl object (set by the c:3158 push, cleared wherever curexpl is reassigned), and both count++ sites move it too.

controls.note: no -C: every match is added before addexpl(0), so both shells list `ex n=2` whether or not the identity is kept

variants.note: no words at all: zsh lists the explanation over the <all> match (count 1); zshrs listed nothing for it (count 0). Fuzz-found: compsys_spec_fuzz seed 4000003 case 88.
